serverMetadata.instructions: speedread: fast, token-budgeted code reading. Prefer its tools over shell cat/sed/head/grep/find/ls and over one-file-at-a-time reads. Batch every file, range and symbol you need into ONE `read` call (`path`, `path:A-B`, `path#Symbol`, `#Symbol`, globs); oversized files come back as skeletons you expand by symbol instead of being cut off. `search` hits show their enclosing function/class; `trace` follows callers, callees, references and implementations; `map` orients you in a repo. After editing a file, read `path@etag` (etag from the `==>` header) to see only what changed.

data.content: Bug report: returning a 2-tuple from a view function is broken: `return 'Created', 201` no longer sets the status code, and `return 'hi', {'X-Foo': 'bar'}` raises an error instead of adding the header. Find and fix the bug in the library code (do not modify tests). Verify with `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests --deselect tests/test_cli.py::test_get_version`. When done, reply with a one-line summary of the fix.

data.content: All 493 tests pass. Fixed a swapped condition in `Flask.make_response` where 2-tuple unpacking assigned `status` when the second element was headers-like and `headers` when it was a status, exactly backwards.
